_comment: Read by tools/check_single_source.py. Each value is written once, in its source file; other files read it from there. See .claude/rules/readable-code.md.

values.why: the profile link; hand-written pages are kept equal by site_brand.py --check
the title suffix; dictionaries translate whole titles, hand-written pages are checked by site_brand.py --check
the number of name files; tools/split_data.py reads it
the size of the world map; build_wals_map.py checks feature-map.html against languoid_map.py
the length of the Stats motion; dist/stats.js reads it
where the repository is; scripts import ROOT and DIST

colours._comment: Colours are tokens in dist/style.css; other files use var(--...) or read the token. The files below draw files that are opened on their own, where the stylesheet does not apply.

also.dist/tree.js: the downloadable SVG of the tree
